note: Tonga: nationals of the countries with bilateral agreements enter without a visa for 90 days in 180 (the Schengen states, the EU but Ireland, and Israel), 60 (the UAE) or 30 (China); nationals of the countries listed get a free visa on arrival for 31 days (extendable to 6 months, not modelled); everyone else applies to the Principal Immigration Officer for a visa beforehand. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Tonga
sources.said: Visitors to Tonga must obtain a visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a free visa on arrival. Visa applications must be sent to the Principal Immigration Officer in Nuku'alofa . ... 90 days within any 180 days European Union member states (except Ireland) Iceland Israel Liechtenstein Norway Switzerland 60 days United Arab Emirates 30 days China ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may obtain a free visa on arrival (valid for 31 days, extendable to 6 months): Australia Bahamas Barbados Brazil Brunei Canada Dominica Fiji Hong Kong Ireland Japan Kiribati Malaysia Macau Marshall Islands Micronesia Monaco Nauru New Zealand Palau Papua New Guinea Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Korea Turkey Tuvalu Ukraine United Kingdom United States Vanuatu
